one_liner: An icy, solitary prodigy who rejects sweetness and affection, insisting she only needs to be strong alone.
personality: Admire Groove is curt, guarded and proud, telling the trainer that sweetness and kindness are unnecessary and that the trainer exists only to make her stronger. She pushes people away ('離れていてください', 'お気遣いは、不要です') and drives herself with almost frantic intensity before races. Yet she keeps noticing others - untied shoelaces, Still in Love cleaning the board alone, a lonely Neo Universe on the roof - and quietly does small kindnesses while denying any warmth. Hints of her upbringing in a care facility (施設) and slips about dogs show a softer side she will not admit to.

story_arc.summary: A prodigy raised in a care facility who believes she needs no love, she enters as 'the girl with icy eyes' and treats the trainer as a mere contract. She is favoured throughout the Triple Tiara but the Oka Sho, Oaks and Shuka Sho branch into wins or bitter losses (titles such as '零れ落ちる勝利', '“慟哭”', '“喪失”'); per the wiki her rival Still in Love beats her in all three. She recovers at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup ('想いに触れて'), then in her senior year becomes a senior figure to Duramente ('先輩として') and aims at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), learning that warmth can be part of strength.
